title: These are just okay
text: These are just okay. These are mediocre. Hard to clean and egg seems to stick regardless of the amount of oil/spray involved. Still holds and cooks the egg well tho. I have switched back to my single egg frying pan

product_metadata.title: Egg Ring 4 Packs 2.95 Inch Egg Ring with Anti-scald Handle with Oil Brush Nonstick Coating Breakfast Tool for Egg Frying/Shaping
features: Egg Rings: Great value egg rings with silicone oil brush, BPA free, refined non-stick coating and fold-up stainless steel handle.

Multi-functional Egg Ring: Egg molds for griddle, egg mcmuffins, sandwiches, biscuits, waffles, pies and pancakes. Make your own food at home anytime. A practical and sweet gift for your friends, lovers and family.
Easy to Use: Once the bottom is cooked, remove ring and flip.
Easy to Clean: Dishwasher safe and easy to clean with towel. Handle folds up to save space for storage. We standby 7/24 to solve any of your product issue.
